name: numeric-conversion-test-6b3e1e5e00/nan-float-as-byte-p.bal
spec_references: Expressions: Literal — Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only
reason: The test creates float NaN with 0.0 / 0.0 and asserts a panic when casting it to byte. Numeric literals, division, local declarations, type casts and function calls are explicitly supported, with no applicable restriction excluding NaN-to-byte conversion or its panic behavior.
test_design_notes: The // @panic marker asserts failure at the byte cast; the test does not check a particular panic message.
